game_start.intro: Mchezo unaanza. Suti ya trump: {trump_suit} (kadi ya trump: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Whist ya Kijerumani.
{phase_info}
Una kadi {hand_size}.
Cheza kadi kwa '[play N]', ambapo N ni nafasi yake katika mkono wako (kwa mfano '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: LEARNING PHASE: the winner of each trick takes the face-up card and the loser draws the next card from the deck. Tricks won in this phase do not count towards victory.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: Nta karata n'imwe igicishwa - igihe co gukina kiratanguye.
next_card.deck_empty: Urutonde rw'amakarata ruragaragara - nta karata na kamwe kariho.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Uburyo bwo gutamba butemewe. Koresha '[play N]' kugira ngo ukine ikarata ya Nth iri mu kuboko kwawe.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: You must follow suit and play a {lead_suit} card.

trick.won_learning: Mchezaji {winner_id} anashinda mchezo huo kwa {card} na kuchukua kadi iliyo wazi.

phase.learning_complete: Umwanya wo kwiga urarangiye, ubuhinga bwose busigaye burakenewe kugira ngo utsinde.

draw.loser_received: Watsinzwe mu buryo bw'amayeri maze ugatora {card} muri karatiye.

turn.scores_learning: Mafungu yaliyoshinda hadi sasa - Mchezaji 0: {tricks0}, Mchezaji 1: {tricks1}

trick_view.empty: No cards played yet this trick.

{observation}
